services.name: College Night
services.desc: Join other students who love theatre for College Night! Enjoy an exclusive pre-show gathering with an artist from the production. College students can purchase advance tickets for just $15 and take part in a curated discussion with one of the artists - with free pizza! Student ID

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Join us for a summer of theatrical learning and creative fun with loads of performance opportunities! Summer camp programs take place at the Playhouse’s mainstage theatre complex in Eden Park/Mt. Adams and Mason Community Center. We believe theatre can be created by any person at any age. That’s what makes camp so exciting! Guided by passionate camp staff, our campers work together to make connections with audiences, each other and themselves, while learning skills that show up onstage and in real life.
